enable.label: Enable paragraph summary enrichment
enable.description: LLM summary per PDF paragraph; billed by token

model.label: Model
model.hint: Recommended: a fast & cheap model (Haiku / DeepSeek / GPT-4o-mini). High call frequency, low reasoning depth — long-context models add cost and latency.

toast.regenerateConfirm: About to regenerate all {{count}} .article.md files. This will consume LLM tokens. Continue?

section.title: Semantic Search (Experimental)
section.description: Builds a local vector index over your library: recall relevant passages with natural-language queries, speed up multi-paper Q&A and reviews, and anchor evidence at paragraph precision. Embedding runs on-device (one-time ~135MB model download) — full text never leaves your machine, zero token cost.

mode.label: Retrieval mode
mode.description: Pick which retrieval tools new Agent sessions get (for A/B evaluation). Vector only: semantic search. Keyword only: ripgrep keyword search, vector indexing stops. Vector + keyword: both. Deep-read tools stay in every mode. Applies to new sessions; the existing index is kept.

model.title: Embedding model
model.missing: Local embedding model not downloaded (~{{size}}). Until it's ready, search falls back to keyword matching

actions.rebuildTooltip: Clear the vector index and re-embed all papers (use after model upgrades or index corruption)

toast.modeChanged: Retrieval mode set to {{mode}} — applies to new Agent sessions
toast.updateFailed: Failed to update semantic search settings
toast.rebuildConfirm: This clears the vector index and re-embeds all papers. Continue?
